title: Inquiry or Investigation
description: Inquiry or investigation into complaints regarding violation of rights of consumers as a class

steps.step: Complaint or reference made to the District Collector by the Central Authority, Commissioner of a regional office, or a consumer
District Collector inquires into or investigates complaints regarding violation of rights of consumers as a class
District Collector submits his report to the Central Authority or to the Commissioner of a regional office
Receive complaint or directions from Central Government or initiate suo motu
